# Only the external libraries FulcrumFS.Videos needs (see FFprobeUtils.cs); everything else is built
# into ffmpeg. --disable-autodetect stops the suite from linking libraries that merely happen to be
# present in MSYS2. zlib is required by the png encoder; libzimg by the zscale filter.
--disable-autodetect
--enable-gpl
--enable-nonfree
--enable-zlib
--enable-libx264
--enable-libx265
--enable-libfdk-aac
--enable-libzimg
--enable-libdav1d
--enable-libvpx
--enable-amf
--enable-cuda
--enable-cuvid
--enable-d3d12va
--enable-d3d11va
--enable-dxva2
--enable-nvenc
--enable-ffnvcodec
--enable-nvdec
--enable-cuda-llvm
--enable-vulkan
--enable-mediafoundation
--enable-opencl
--enable-libvpl
--enable-libplacebo
--enable-libglslang
--disable-debug
